description: This file defines the LanguageSearchFilterParams class, which extends a filter parameters base class to include sorting functionality for language search features within the OrangeHRM Admin plugin. It specifies allowed sort fields and sets a default sort field in the constructor.

classes.name: LanguageSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object class used to encapsulate filtering parameters for language search functionalities, including allowed sort fields and default sorting behavior.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of LanguageSearchFilterParams, setting the default sort field to 'l.name'.
